Write a resume for a junior hardware engineer. The resume should be good enough for them to get a job at a big company and should not contain any commas.

***

# JORDAN SMITH
San Jose CA 95134
(555) 123-4567
jordan.smith@email.com
linkedin.com/in/jordan-smith-hw

**PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY**
Motivated junior hardware engineer with strong foundation in digital logic design analog circuits and microprocessor architecture. Proficient in Verilog VHDL and C programming languages. Skilled in PCB design using Altium Designer and Cadence Virtuoso. Eager to contribute to innovative projects at a leading technology company.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**
*   Hardware Description Languages: Verilog VHDL SystemVerilog
*   PCB Design Tools: Altium Designer Cadence Virtuoso KiCad
*   Programming Languages: C C++ Python
*   Embedded Systems: ARM Cortex Microcontrollers FPGA Development
*   Testing & Debugging: Logic Analyzers Oscilloscopes Multimeters
*   Operating Systems: Linux Windows Embedded Linux

**PROJECT EXPERIENCE**

**Embedded System Design Project**
*   Designed and implemented a real-time clock system using an ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller
*   Wrote efficient C code to manage interrupts and peripheral communication
*   Created schematic diagrams and printed circuit board layouts for the final product
*   Conducted extensive testing using logic analyzers to verify signal integrity
*   Optimized power consumption to extend battery life by 20 percent

**FPGA Accelerator Development**
*   Developed a high-speed data processing pipeline using Verilog on Xilinx Artix-7 FPGA
*   Implemented pipelining techniques to increase throughput by 40 percent
*   Integrated the FPGA design with a host PC via USB interface
*   Debugged timing violations using Xilinx Vivado simulation tools
*   Documented design specifications and test procedures for future reference

**ANALOG CIRCUIT DESIGN PROJECT**
*   Designed a low-noise amplifier circuit for sensor signal conditioning
*   Simulated circuit performance using LTSpice before fabrication
*   Built prototype boards and measured gain bandwidth and noise floor
*   Iteratively improved component selection to meet strict noise requirements
*   Collaborated with team members to integrate the analog stage into a larger system

**EDUCATION**

**Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering**
University of California Berkeley
Graduated May 2023
*   Relevant Coursework: Digital Logic Design Analog Circuits Microprocessors Signals and Systems
*   GPA: 3.8/4.0
*   Honors: Dean's List all semesters

**CERTIFICATIONS**
*   Xilinx FPGA Application Engineer Certification
*   Altium Certified PCB Designer

**VOLUNTEER EXPERIENCE**

**Electronics Club Member**
University of California Berkeley
*   Organized weekly workshops for freshmen on basic circuit theory
*   Mentored students on using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
*   Coordinated the annual hackathon event for hardware engineering teams
*   Assisted in building educational kits for underrepresented students
